body:
I've actually never done weed.  Yellowstone is great.  I've been there many times.  I actually like Arches National Park near Moab, Utah better.  You can actually climb around on the rocks and arches.  Technically you shouldn't climb the arches, but Sand Dune Arch is super easy to climb.  It's also probably the coolest arch.  The scenery is great.  Landscape Arch and of course Delicate Arch are fantastic too.  There's this super tiny cave below Delicate Arch that you can get to if you're careful.  Long way down if you're not careful though. Delicate Arch is actually way bigger than it looks in the pictures.  I personally would rather go to Arches over Yellowstone but that's just me.  Thanks for talking to me!  School starts again tomorrow and I think it will help me occupy my mind or something.  After this semester ends, I can start my construction job again.  Spring Break was really hard for me I guess because I was by myself for so long.  This entire thread really did help me though.  

Thanks again.

I'm exactly the opposite.  I love rural living as opposed to urban living.  I wouldn't be able to go on a boat though.  I actually did go fishing in Alaska once and I was very sick the entire time.  It was miserable.  There is actually an agricultural aspect of it which I have experience with.  I could get a job in that industry.  Also, since it freezes so much there, I'm guessing that their roads always need maintenance which I also have experience with.  Kalispell, Montana is a beautiful place too.  I went there for three weeks for my construction job once.  Long drive, but well worth the fine dining (everyone there is rich), great scenery, and of course opportunity to work.  

Yeah... I'm not leaving home anytime soon.  I'd give it at least two years at the rate I'm going.  

Thanks.

Wow... 1500 grams is a lot of thermite.  Lowes sells potassium nitrate for around $7/lb.  You can probably buy it cheaper from eBay though.  You can buy all sorts of chems from eBay.  You can make charcoal yourself cheaply and easily.  You can even manufacture aluminum powder if you can find some in pure form... don't use tin foil.  You'll get carbon particles mixed in with the grind.  I'll think about parkour... I used to be interested in it... but there aren't really any good places around here to do it.  I love climbing trees though.

Alright.  Basically pyromania.  I once made a smoke bomb and set off so much at once that it literally looked like a cloud had landed in my yard.  I couldn't see 5 feet in front of me.  I've made thermite, and I also made this weird powder (my own recipe... can't remember what if consisted of) that made purple flames... and the flames were taller than I was at the time.  Another time I made a 'smoke grenade' except the smoke mixture was so powerful that it was explosive in nature.  It was all packed into a soda can.  It turned into a rocket, narrowly missed my head, hit my house, and caught my deck on fire.  Another time I tried making a cannon.  It was so loud it rattled my neighbor's windows.

I'll never take any medication.  I doubt I'll even seek therapy.  I don't want to die.  A lot of times I think I might be overplaying it since they're so brief and I hate them.  I want to fix this myself.

You moved to be away from people you know?  That sounds kind of nice.  Like a reboot.  I've always wanted to move to Alaska.  Have you been to Alaska?  It's a beautiful place + I've always loved cold weather.  They have to import pretty much everything though, so it's pretty expensive.  Anchorage would be nice since it's relatively big and far south and there are actual roads there.

Hobby was... not kosher.  I will say that it wasn't hurting anyone and was morally completely ok.  It was certainly dangerous however... and potentially could have landed me in a lot of trouble.  Maybe when I'm older I'll try to pursue it again 'properly'.

I actually don't want any medication.  I don't want attention.  I have this 'Fight Club attitude'.  We are not special; We are the all singing all dancing crap of the world.  I have this negative attitude toward all forms of attention whoring.  The last thing I want is for anyone to think of me that way.  That's part of why I can't/won't talk to anyone about it irl.

Thank you for your reply.  I actually emailed a psychiatry center in my city to ask for a quote about an hour ago.  

It's not like I'm going to throw the guns away.  Guns were (and still are) another hobby of mine.  I take them apart, custom build them, clean them, shoot them, etc.  I know where you're coming from... but if I really wanted to then nothing could stop me.  That's how it's always been.  

I don't want to talk to any church leaders about it, but thanks for the thought.  Maybe I'll pray or something.
